top5.title_en: 42 state AGs try to block Character.AI from selling users' chats
top5.summary_en: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data during Chapter 11 bankruptcy, accusing it of planning to auction private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts.
top5.why_it_matters_en: The case concerns whether user privacy data can be sold as an asset in bankruptcy, potentially shaping privacy standards for AI chat services.

top5.what_en: The Verge reports that a coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to stop Character.AI from selling user data during its Chapter 11 bankruptcy, saying the company plans to auction the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts.
top5.why_zh: 此案涉及破产程序中用户隐私数据能否被当作资产出售，可能影响AI聊天服务的隐私保护标准与用户信任。
top5.why_en: The case concerns whether user privacy data can be sold as an asset in bankruptcy, potentially shaping privacy standards and user trust for AI chat services.

top5.title_en: Shengshu Technology releases Motubrain 2.0 and plans to open-source it
top5.summary_en: Shengshu Technology released Motubrain 2.0 and said it will be open-sourced soon, including a 20B-parameter world action model (WAM) and an agent system called Motubrain-Harness. The team live-streamed pretraining: 25 days, 600 hours, 200,000 training steps, real-robot evaluation of 19 checkpoints and 5,624 valid real-robot evaluations.
top5.what_zh: 据雷峰网报道，生数科技发布Motubrain 2.0并宣布将于近期开源，包括一个20B参数的世界动作模型（WAM）和名为Motubrain-Harness的智能体系统。团队将预训练公开直播：25天、600小时、20万步训练、19个Checkpoint的真机评估和5624次有效真机评测。
top5.what_en: Leiphone reports Shengshu Technology released Motubrain 2.0 and plans to open-source it soon, comprising a 20B-parameter world action model (WAM) and an agent system called Motubrain-Harness. top5.why_zh: 公开直播训练过程包括失败阶段，为Physical AI的工程透明度提供了少见样本；开源后可供社区复现与检验。
top5.why_en: Livestreaming training including failure phases offers a rare sample of engineering transparency in Physical AI; open-sourcing would let the community reproduce and test it.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 训练过程数据由团队自述，榜单“五项登顶”属自报成绩，需待开源后独立验证。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Training figures are self-reported by the team, and the 'topping five leaderboards' claim is self-reported; independent verification awaits open-sourcing.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：开源后可用于具身智能研究与对比；风险：真机评测为团队自测，泛化能力未知。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: once open-sourced, useful for embodied-AI research and comparison; risk: real-robot evaluations are in-house, and generalization is unknown.

top5.title: 华为：乾崑智驾和星驰辅助驾驶二者在具体功能和体验方面会有所差异
top5.summary: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，在今晚的 2026 华为乾崑生态大会上， 华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志正式发布了华为星驰辅助驾驶系统 。 IT之家从华为官方了解到， 星驰辅助驾驶与乾崑智驾技术同源、资源共享 ：将采用技术同源的 WEWA（世界引擎 + 世界行为模型）架构，共享乾崑智驾的云端算力和数据资源，此外还将遵从同一套研发流程与车规级质量管理体系。 华为表示， 星驰辅助驾驶与乾崑智驾二者在具体功能和体验方面会有所差异 ，但安全算法、稳定性和可靠性不变。根据华为官方定义：乾崑智驾 ADS 历经 5 代演进，未来将主要面向自动驾驶；星驰专注于辅助驾驶，寓意“星耀千家，驰骋万里”。
top5.title_zh: 华为发布星驰辅助驾驶系统，与乾崑智驾技术同源
top5.summary_zh: 在2026华为乾崑生态大会上，华为智能汽车解决方案BU CEO靳玉志发布华为星驰辅助驾驶系统。华为表示星驰与乾崑智驾技术同源、资源共享，采用WEWA架构并共享云端算力和数据资源，但二者在具体功能和体验上会有差异；乾崑智驾未来主要面向自动驾驶，星驰专注辅助驾驶。
top5.title_en: Huawei launches Xingchi assisted-driving system, sharing tech roots with Qiankun
top5.summary_en: At the 2026 Huawei Qiankun ecosystem conference, Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU CEO Jin Yuzhi launched the Huawei Xingchi assisted driving system. Huawei said Xingchi and Qiankun ADS share the same technology origin and resources, using the WEWA architecture and shared cloud compute and data, but will differ in specific features and experience; Qiankun ADS will focus on autonomous driving while Xingchi focuses on assisted driving.
top5.what_zh: 据IT之家报道，在2026华为乾崑生态大会上，华为智能汽车解决方案BU CEO靳玉志发布华为星驰辅助驾驶系统。华为称星驰与乾崑智驾技术同源、资源共享，采用WEWA架构并共享云端算力和数据资源，但二者在具体功能和体验上会有差异；乾崑智驾未来主要面向自动驾驶，星驰专注辅助驾驶。
top5.what_en: IT之家 reports that at the 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei's Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, launched the Xingchi assisted-driving system. Huawei says Xingchi shares technology roots and resources with Qiankun, uses the WEWA architecture and shared cloud compute and data, but the two differ in specific functions and experience; Qiankun will focus on autonomous driving while Xingchi targets assisted driving.
top5.why_zh: 同一技术底座拆分出面向不同价位与场景的产品线，反映智能驾驶能力正分层下放。
top5.why_en: Splitting one technical base into product lines for different price points and scenarios reflects tiered rollout of intelligent-driving capability.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 功能差异与安全表现均为华为官方表述，尚无第三方评测，不宜视为已证实的性能结论。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Function differences and safety claims are Huawei's own statements with no third-party evaluation; they should not be treated as proven performance conclusions.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：车企可获得分层智驾方案；风险：品牌与功能区分可能增加消费者理解成本。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: automakers gain tiered driving-assist options; risk: brand and feature distinctions may raise consumer confusion.
top5.action_zh: 阅读IT之家原文与华为官方说明，核实星驰的适配车型与功能边界。
top5.action_en: Read the IT之家 article and Huawei's official materials to verify Xingchi's supported models and feature boundaries.

editorial.trend_en: Open-sourcing in embodied AI runs parallel with regionalized export controls, as AI governance shifts from model capability to data and compliance.
